summary: Of 68 visible search terms, 21 also rank in Search Console. After 5 live checks in Colorado, 1 term is worth a bid-down test: "water heater repair" ranks #1, no rival ad shows beside ours, and a conversion its ad adds costs about $93.33 against the $65 target, so a 4-week pause could save about $420 a month for about 4.5 conversions at risk. The brand term ranks #1 but stays: a conversion it adds costs about $15.79 even if half its clicks are free. "drain cleaning" holds map-pack slot 1, but competitor-b.example bids on it, so the ad defends the slot. The bigger finding runs the other way: 30 of the 47 converting non-brand search terms do not show up in Search Console at all, so ads alone carry them.
